PACKING — Problem-Solution Guide

40 Amazing Things To See & Do in Zanzibar

Solving: overwhelming choice, where to start

Message us on WhatsApp for a personalized Zanzibar experiences list

The Problem

Many travelers to Zanzibar face: overwhelming choice, where to start. With 16 tours, 213 hotels, 60 attractions, and 14 zones, planning a trip can feel impossible. This guide cuts through the noise to prioritize what matters most for your travel style.

Top 40 Experiences — Curated by Dhow Coast Travels

Stone Town & Culture (6 experiences)

  1. Stone Town walking tour — UNESCO Heritage site, sultan's palace, bustling markets
  2. Spice farm journey — cloves, vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg sensory walk
  3. Prison Island + Nakupenda — giant tortoises, sandbank sunset
  4. Freddie Mercury House — Zanzibar's most famous son's childhood home
  5. Forodhani Night Market — grilled seafood, Zanzibar pizza, local street food
  6. Anglican Cathedral — former slave market, memory & reconciliation

Northern Beaches & Activities (8 experiences)

  1. Nungwi beach — white sand, turquoise water, sunset dhow cruises
  2. Mnemba Atoll snorkeling — pristine coral, green sea turtles, dolphins
  3. Dolphin watching — Kizimkazi morning trips, pods surfing waves
  4. Turtle nesting experiences — night visits with guided conservation
  5. Kendwa full-moon parties — beach clubs, all-night dancing, fire shows
  6. Traditional dhow building — Nungyi yard, hand-sawn planks, no power tools
  7. Kuza Cave — Jambiani freshwater pools, sacred rituals, oral histories
  8. Seaweed farming visit — women's cooperatives, low-tide planting, drying

Southeastern Beaches & Adventures (8 experiences)

  1. Paje kitesurfing — world-class lagoon, shallow water, rental schools
  2. Jambiani village tour — Swahili culture, seaweed farms, Kuza Cave pools
  3. Mkwaja sandbank — picnic, snorkeling, total isolation
  4. Jozani Forest — red colobus monkeys, mangrove walk, endemic species
  5. Pemba Island — unspoiled reefs, diving, secret coves (ferry required)
  6. Chumbe Island coral park — protected marine reserve, snorkeling only
  7. Bwejuu beach — palm-fringed, relaxed, family-friendly, no tide issues
  8. Kiwengwa resort strip — all-inclusive, Mnemba access, protected lagoon

Marine & Island Adventures (8 experiences)

  1. Safari Blue / Menai Bay dhow day — Fumba, sandbar barbecue, snorkeling stops
  2. Sunset dhow cruise — ocean, champagne, dolphins, coastline perspective
  3. Private beach dinner — candles, tide, personalized menu, star gazing
  4. Island hopping — Mnemba, Pemba, Prison Island in one day
  5. Fly-in safari to Serengeti — Zanzibar then Tanzania's premier wildlife
  6. Fly-in safari to Mikumi — Zanzibar then Big Five day trip
  7. Mnemba sunset champagne — private boat, canapés, sunset sky
  8. Deep-sea fishing — big game, charter, marlin, tuna, sailfish

Cultural Immersion & Logistics (10 experiences)

  1. Swahili home cooking class — market tour, family meal, recipe cards
  2. Cultural village visit — Kizimbani or Jambiani, seaweed, crafts, daily life
  3. Stone Town evening culture walk — taarab music, heritage sites, rooftop chai
  4. Dhow sailing overnight — sleep under stars, island coast, no light pollution
  5. Zanzibar culinary tour — 5-taste experience, spice history, local pairing
  6. Best time to visit — monthly calendar, migration, whale sharks, turtle
  7. What to pack — essentials, seasonal, climate, cultural respect items
  8. Health & safety — malaria prevention, safe beaches, turtle encounters, emergency
  9. Transport options — self-drive 4x4, airport transfers, local daladalas
  10. Custom itinerary planning — WhatsApp consult, dates + interests → personalized plan
